american_bollworm.cause: High humidity, infected soil, or pests.
american_bollworm.spread_method: Wind, water splash, or insect vectors.
american_bollworm.organic_treatment: Apply organic neem-based solutions or copper fungicides. Remove infected plant parts.
american_bollworm.chemical_treatment: Spray broad-spectrum fungicide or bactericide approved for Cotton.
american_bollworm.safety_precautions: Wear PPE when spraying. Observe pre-harvest intervals.
